_what: Where the Workshop seam of meaning-search (read-data/meaning-search.mjs) finds the person's index descriptors and vector sets. `kinds` names every record kind the package's scripts read (its semantic-index-descriptor, capability-index source descriptor, readiness policy and convergence rows, in the person's own records, read through the records door). Scripts never name a kind in code; they read it here. `files` is the operation of the files door that reads a span of one of the person's files; `read_bytes` is how much one read asks for. `index_batch_bytes` bounds the JSON plan sent to every indexing process; a single item larger than the bound is processed alone. `embedding_property` and `attribute_table` are the names the package's own scripts write embedding facts under (make-embedding-facts-from-command-output.py), so the seam hands the ranker exactly the facts the package wrote.
